title: FORD MOTOR CO 8-K Filing — 2026-04-15
summary: Ford Motor Company filed an 8-K on April 15, 2026 disclosing amendments to four credit agreements, extending maturity dates on approximately $18.5 billion in credit facilities. This is a routine corporate credit facility amendment with no direct relevance to market structure or macro catalysts.
key_points: Ford entered the Twenty-Third Amendment to its Credit Agreement: $3.4B commitments extended from April 17, 2028 to April 13, 2029; $10.1B commitments extended from April 17, 2030 to April 15, 2031
Ford entered the Eighth Amendment to its Supplemental Revolving Credit Agreement: $2.0B commitments extended from April 17, 2028 to April 13, 2029
Ford entered the 364-Day Fifth Amendment: $2.5B commitments extended from April 16, 2026 to April 14, 2027
Ford entered the Term Loan First Amendment: $3.0B commitments extended availability from July 28, 2026 to December 31, 2026
JPMorgan Chase Bank, N.A. serves as administrative agent for all facilities
Total commitments affected: approximately $18.5 billion across four facilities
why_it_matters: This is a routine corporate credit amendment by Ford Motor Company. It has no relevance to Federal Reserve policy, interest rate decisions, economic data releases, Treasury market operations, or broader market structure. It is a single corporate borrower's private credit facility modification and does not constitute a macro catalyst.
